prompt: I’m going on a weekend trip to Germany and have limited space in my luggage. I’m choosing between taking with me either an umbrella or a waterproof jacket. Which one will me more useful to take with me?
response: For a trip to Germany, an umbrella is more practical than a waterproof jacket. It takes up less space and is more versatile for various weather conditions. A jacket can be bulky and is often unnecessary if you have an umbrella to keep you dry. You can easily find a waterproof jacket at your destination if needed.
